sources.quote: HAT-P-33b is a planet in the orbit of HAT-P-33, which lies 1,310 light-years away from Earth.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-33. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-33b"
sources.quote: Its discovery was reported in June 2011, although it was suspected to be a planet as early as 2004.
